brief.title: Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
brief.one_liner: A data-driven ranking of the world's top commercial organizations by their employees' open source contributions on GitHub.
brief.goal: The viewer should understand which companies lead in open source contributions, how the ecosystem is growing month-over-month, and what technologies dominate the open source landscape.

sections.title: Top 10 Contributing Organizations
sections.objective: Present the ranked leaderboard of companies by active contributors and total community size, including month-over-month growth.

sections.title: Top Programming Languages
sections.objective: Visualize the distribution of programming languages used across open source contributions tracked by OSCI.

sections.title: Ecosystem Scale & Licensing
sections.objective: Highlight the total number of organizations tracked and the dominant open source licenses in use.

sections.title: Monthly Growth Momentum
sections.objective: Emphasize the month-over-month increases in active contributors and community members to show accelerating engagement.
